main_text.p: lio: vt omnes honorent Filium, prout honorant Patrem.
main_text.head: LI. Quid nobis prodest hæc gloria nostri capitis Christi?
main_text.p: Primum, quod per spiritum sanctum in nos sua membra, cœlestia dona effundit Ephef. 4. v. 10. 11. 12. Qui descendit, ipse est qui etiam ascendit longè supra omnes cœlos, vt impleret omnia. Dedit igitur ipse alios quidem, Apostolos: alios vero, Prophetas: alios autem, Euangelistas: alios autem, Pastores & doctores: Ad coagmentationem sanctorum, ad opus ministerij, ad ædificationem, inquam, corporis Christi. a.Deinde, quòd nos sua potentia contra omnes hostes protegit ac defendit b.
{b} Psalm. 2. v. 9. Conteres eas virga ferrea, ficut vas figuli confringes eas.

Psalm. 110. v. 1, 2. Dixit Dominus Domino meo: Sede ad dextram meam, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedibus tuis. Virgam fortitudinis tuæ mittet Dominus ex Sion, dominare in medio inimicorum tuorum.

page.notes: Superscript reference marks in the left column are partly unclear; the marginal note in the right column is printed in full-width small type and the Ephes. reference is read from the printed "Ephef.4.v.10". The "Ioh." line is a bare reference at lower right. The catchword-like marks and the stray slash at the bottom are not printed text.
